mapper.insert: insert into POST (POST_ID, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, POST_FILE, VIEW_COUNT, LIKES, USR_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) values (POST_SEQ.nextval, #{postTitle}, #{postContent}, #{postFile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 0, #{usrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: select POST_ID as postId, POST_TITLE as postTitle, POST_CONTENT as postContent, POST_FILE as postFile, VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, LIKES as likes, USR_ID as usrId, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt from POST where POST_ID = #{postId}

select POST_ID as postId, POST_TITLE as postTitle, POST_CONTENT as postContent, POST_FILE as postFile, VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, LIKES as likes, USR_ID as usrId, CREATED_AT as createdAt, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt from POST where POST_TITLE like '%' || #{search} || '%' or USR_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%' or POST_CONTENT like '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.update: update POST set POST_TITLE = #{postTitle}, POST_CONTENT = #{postContent}, POST_FILE = #{postFile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE where POST_ID = #{postId}
update POST set LIKES = LIKES + 1 where POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.select: select LIKES from POST where POST_ID = #{postId}
SELECT CMT_ID as commentId, POST_ID as postId, USR_ID as usrId, CMT_CONTENT as content, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM COMMENTS WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS (CMT_ID, POST_ID, USR_ID, CMT_CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (COMMENT_SEQ.nextval, #{postId}, #{usrId}, #{content}, SYSDATE)
